title: Electron Genome
purpose: Immutable canonical description of what the virtual electron is.

title: Genome Manifest
purpose: Declares version, schema, capabilities, dependencies, and compatible VM targets.

title: Genome SHA-256 Identity
purpose: Cryptographic fingerprint of the electron definition.

title: Canonical PA-LCTL Program
purpose: Portable executable representation shared across the DF VM suite.

title: Electron Intermediate Representation (EIR)
purpose: VM-independent representation between the genome and target-specific lowering.

title: Electron ID
purpose: Unique persistent identity for a virtual electron instance.

title: Generation ID
purpose: Indicates clone or fork generation.

title: Parent ID
purpose: Records which virtual electron produced a clone.

title: Lineage Record
purpose: Maintains the complete ancestry chain for cloned electrons.

title: Genesis Record
purpose: Sealed initial configuration and state of the original electron.

title: Charge Register
purpose: Represents the logical electron charge, normally -1.

title: Energy Register
purpose: Stores the current virtual energy level.

title: Orbital Register
purpose: Stores the current logical orbital, plugin, or execution assignment.

title: State Register
purpose: Stores the general electron state identifier.

title: Phase Register
purpose: Provides a deterministic phase or state-cycle representation.

title: Spin Register
purpose: Provides a logical two-state property such as UP/DOWN or 0/1.

title: Momentum Vector
purpose: Optional software representation of directional execution state.

title: Position/Node Vector
purpose: Represents location within the virtual fabric rather than physical space.

title: Interaction Radius
purpose: Defines which other virtual entities the electron may communicate with.

title: Energy Transition Table
purpose: Defines legal changes between virtual energy levels.

title: Instruction Decoder
purpose: Interprets canonical electron operations.

title: State Transition Engine
purpose: Computes State(t+1) from State(t) deterministically.

title: Register Bank
purpose: Holds active runtime values for the electron.

title: Local Working Memory
purpose: Provides bounded mutable execution workspace.

title: Persistent State Pointer
purpose: Connects the electron to durable state maintained outside local working memory.

title: Deterministic Clock/Tick Counter
purpose: Provides repeatable logical execution ordering.

title: Deterministic PRNG
purpose: Provides reproducible pseudorandom behavior when required.

title: Instruction Counter
purpose: Tracks executed operations.

title: Resource Meter
purpose: Accounts for CPU, time, memory, storage, and step budgets.

title: Execution Status Register
purpose: Tracks running, suspended, blocked, faulted, and verified execution states.

title: Mailbox
purpose: Receives messages and events destined for a virtual electron.

title: Outbound Queue
purpose: Buffers messages awaiting delivery.

title: Interaction Bus Adapter
purpose: Connects an electron to DF_Fabric messaging and transport.

title: Peer Address Resolver
purpose: Locates other virtual particles and components.

title: Signal Encoder
purpose: Converts internal state and events into Fabric messages.

title: Signal Decoder
purpose: Converts Fabric messages into validated electron events.

title: Event Router
purpose: Routes interactions to the correct handler.

title: Subscription Table
purpose: Defines events to which the electron responds.

title: Binding Table
purpose: Associates the electron with plugins, agents, tools, or workloads.

title: Interaction Policy
purpose: Defines which entities the electron is permitted to contact and under what conditions.

title: Freeze Controller
purpose: Halts the source electron at a deterministic state boundary.

title: State Canonicalizer
purpose: Converts VM-specific state into the common VEC state form.

title: Snapshot Engine
purpose: Produces sealed electron snapshots.

title: Snapshot Hash
purpose: Cryptographically identifies a clone point.

title: Fork Controller
purpose: Creates child electron instances from sealed state.

title: Clone-ID Generator
purpose: Creates unique descendant identifiers.

title: Copy-on-Write State Store
purpose: Avoids copying unchanged state for every clone.

title: Clone Manifest
purpose: Describes parent, child, snapshot, genome, and creation event.

title: Restore Engine
purpose: Instantiates an electron from a validated snapshot.

title: Clone Equivalence Tester
purpose: Confirms parent and clone began from identical canonical state.

title: Canonical State Hash
purpose: Fingerprints the current logical state.

title: Capability Hash
purpose: Fingerprints the permitted capability set.

title: Configuration Hash
purpose: Fingerprints runtime configuration.

title: Execution Receipt
purpose: Records what program ran, under which inputs, and its outcome.

title: Attestation Record
purpose: Records which VM nodes independently verified execution.

title: Append-Only Event Ledger
purpose: Maintains the permanent electron history.

title: Replay Engine
purpose: Reconstructs execution from recorded deterministic events.

title: Tamper Detector
purpose: Rejects altered genome, state, manifest, and ledger artifacts.

title: Schema Validator
purpose: Rejects malformed or incompatible VEC structures.

title: Fail-Closed Gate Controller
purpose: Prevents unverified instances or transitions from becoming operational.

title: DF_Small Adapter
purpose: Provides the minimal/reference VEC implementation on DF_Small.

title: MSSL Lowering Backend
purpose: Produces DF_Small-compatible MSSL representation.

title: DF_Medium Adapter
purpose: Provides the main semantic/compiler validation environment.

title: Medium LCTLC Backend
purpose: Generates DF_Medium-specific LCTLC executable form.

title: DF_Large Adapter
purpose: Provides service, device, and external-interface execution on DF_Large.

title: Large LCTLC Backend
purpose: Generates DF_Large-specific LCTLC executable form.

title: DF_Xtra_Large Adapter
purpose: Provides large-state and long-running electron execution.

title: XL/QVM Lowering Backend
purpose: Generates DF_Xtra_Large/QVM-compatible execution form.

title: Result Normalizer
purpose: Maps target-specific result conventions into the common VEC result model.

title: Cross-Target Comparator
purpose: Verifies that all target manifestations produce equivalent logical results.

title: Electron Registry
purpose: Catalogs active, dormant, suspended, and retired VEC instances.

title: Fabric Scheduler
purpose: Determines when and where electrons execute.

title: Placement Engine
purpose: Assigns electrons to Small, Medium, Large, and Xtra-Large nodes.

title: Replica Manager
purpose: Creates and supervises parallel execution replicas.

title: Quorum Manager
purpose: Determines whether independent results reach the configured agreement threshold.

title: Differential Verification Engine
purpose: Compares heterogeneous-node results and identifies divergences.

title: Fabric Event Log
purpose: Maintains the distributed execution and coordination history.

title: Transport Layer
purpose: Moves messages, state, receipts, and control records between VM nodes.

title: Node Discovery System
purpose: Locates compatible VM instances and their capability profiles.

title: Health Monitor
purpose: Determines whether VM hosts and VEC services are usable.

title: Recovery Coordinator
purpose: Restarts or reconstructs failed electron instances.

title: Checkpoint Coordinator
purpose: Coordinates consistent distributed snapshots.

title: Capability Manifest
purpose: Explicitly states what the electron may do.

title: Capability Tokens
purpose: Grants narrowly scoped, time- or context-bound permissions.

title: Resource Quotas
purpose: Constrains CPU, RAM, steps, storage, network, and concurrency.

title: Filesystem Sandbox
purpose: Restricts local filesystem access.

title: Network Sandbox
purpose: Restricts outbound and inbound network connectivity.

title: Host-Call Gate
purpose: Controls calls into Windows or other host services.

title: Plugin Gate
purpose: Controls which plugins may be bound to a VEC orbital.

title: Privilege Boundary
purpose: Separates electron execution authority from Fabric administration.

title: Kill/Suspend Switch
purpose: Provides deterministic suspension and termination control.

title: Recovery Policy
purpose: Defines permitted restart, replay, rollback, and reconstruction behavior.

title: Orbital Manager
purpose: Assigns VECs to computational orbitals.

title: Electron Pool
purpose: Maintains available VEC workers and lifecycle state.

title: Electron Affinity Map
purpose: Determines preferred proton, neutron, workload, and node associations.

title: Proton Interface
purpose: Connects electrons to function or type components.

title: Neutron Interface
purpose: Connects electrons to persistence and management components.

title: Atomic Membership Record
purpose: States which QAM atom owns or contains the electron.

title: Bond Interface
purpose: Allows atoms and electrons to form higher-order computational structures.

title: Orbital Transition Controller
purpose: Moves electrons between plugin or function roles under controlled policy.

title: Electron Inspector
purpose: Displays live and historical VEC internal state.

title: Lineage Viewer
purpose: Visualizes clone ancestry and fork relationships.

title: Orbital Viewer
purpose: Visualizes current and historical orbital role and binding.

title: State-Diff Viewer
purpose: Compares parent, clone, checkpoint, and target-normalized states.

title: Execution Trace Viewer
purpose: Displays instruction, event, and transition history.

title: Fabric Topology View
purpose: Displays which VM hosts each manifestation, replica, and service.

title: Quorum Dashboard
purpose: Displays replica agreement, disagreement, and quorum evidence.

title: Resource Dashboard
purpose: Displays CPU, memory, step, storage, and transport consumption.

title: Attestation Viewer
purpose: Displays validation and verification evidence.

title: Clone Laboratory UI
purpose: Provides operator workflows to create, freeze, fork, compare, restore, and retire VECs.
